declarations.docstring: Computes the coefficient of the displayed product by testing agreement of the permutation-paired exponent entries.
If a natural-valued indexing function is injective, the coefficient of the auxiliary power series at its associated auxiliary exponent index is one.
Associates an auxiliary finitely supported exponent index to a natural-valued function on finite indices.
The auxiliary exponent index has value `α i` at `Sum.inl i`.
The auxiliary exponent index has value `α j` at `Sum.inr j`.
